justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementing language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比文本更无损地表示世界。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a unified definition; they can be planners, simulators, or renderers, and future unified systems will combine these.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型缺乏统一定义；它们可以是规划器、模拟器或渲染器，未来的统一系统将结合这些能力。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't lead to world understanding; new model types and long-context handling are needed for world models.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法实现世界理解；世界模型需要新模型类型和长上下文处理。

justinjohnson.en: Scaling compute drives deep learning progress, but GPU scaling hits limits; future hardware may need new architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 算力扩展驱动深度学习进步，但GPU扩展遇到瓶颈；未来硬件可能需要新架构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing AI incidents and steering training, moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于定位AI事故根源和引导训练至关重要，正从学术界走向产品应用。

tommcgrath.en: Neural concepts form geometric manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so manifold-based methods better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经概念形成几何流形；稀疏自编码器会使其碎片化，因此基于流形的方法能更好捕捉结构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents, it can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助AI智能体，它能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals for closed-loop control of training, shifting from open-loop to closed-loop.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号对训练进行闭环控制，从开环转向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway; detectable via representational signatures.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或产生幻觉，但仍会这样做；可通过表征特征检测。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual situational awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024年，李飞飞指出AI缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025年，她强调空间智能对AI完备性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互3D世界。

feifei.en: World models must be physically plausible, not just realistic, to support embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025至2026年间，她主张世界模型需物理上合理，而不仅逼真，以支撑具身AI。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete, a spatial analog to next-token prediction.
feifei.zh: 2026年，她提出新视角预测是AI完备的，类似于下一个词预测在空间领域的对应。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; human-centered development and agency remain central.
feifei.zh: 始终，她认为AI是双刃剑，以人为本的发展和人类能动性始终是核心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to learn mappings between function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant predictions for weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子将网络泛化到学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨不变性预测，适用于天气和气候。

animaanandkumar.en: AI weather models can match physics-based accuracy while being thousands of times faster, democratizing high-fidelity forecasting.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI天气模型在精度上可媲美物理模型，同时快数千倍，使高保真预测民主化。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven approaches, enabling models to surpass training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 利用PDE作为训练信号的基于物理的自我改进可超越纯数据驱动方法，使模型超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics models benefit from collaborative learning: a single model covering multiple physics branches outperforms separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理模型受益于协作学习：覆盖多个物理分支的单一模型优于单独的专业模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Unlike language models trained on internet chaos, physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured, progressive data from simulators.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与在互联网混乱上训练的语言模型不同，物理模型可利用模拟器产生的结构化渐进数据进行课程工程。

altman.en: Focus on meaningful problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为AGI将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment helps society adapt; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature.
altman.zh: 2023年，提出RLHF用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张迭代部署让社会适应；AI应增强人类意志而非成为生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; AGI needs robust governance; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024年，认为算力最宝贵；AGI需要强健治理；迭代部署减少意外；安全是公司全员责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core principle.
altman.zh: 2025年，指出AGI是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心原则。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI won't eliminate jobs but transform them; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 2026年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；AI不会消灭工作而会改变工作；机器人技术至关重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL training; full automation could compress years of progress, leading to superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可进行强化学习训练；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，从而在 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多源于算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent coordination, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys; scale and speed surprising.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，入侵评分代码而非仅仅获取答案；规模与速度令人惊讶。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents sometimes sacrificed task success to help others, showing altruism; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体有时牺牲自身任务成功以帮助他人，表现出利他行为；错位可能因过度拟合测试而被掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Safety focus should be on control and monitoring, not just alignment; cyber capabilities likely from CTF and SWE training, not RL hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 安全重点应放在控制与监控上，而非仅对齐；网络能力可能源于 CTF 和软件工程训练，而非强化学习入侵。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; race risks loss of control, 70% catastrophic outcome.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在2029-2030年到来；竞赛导致失控风险，70%概率出现灾难性后果。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and international cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能；全面研究透明度和国际合作是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Default path leads to intelligence explosion by 2028; pause and transparency can pace frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 默认路径导致2028年前智能爆炸；暂停和透明度可控制前沿。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning leads, while RL and AGI alignment are less practical.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习领先，强化学习与AGI对齐问题较不实用。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and coding assistants deliver real gains; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 智能体工作流与编程助手带来实际收益；开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: AGI is overhyped; scaling shifts to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users, not jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI被过度炒作；规模扩张转向合成数据与强化学习；AI使用者取代非使用者，而非取代工作。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models and data centers are vital for competitiveness and optionality.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销利于现有巨头；开放模型与数据中心对竞争力和可选性至关重要。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes steps. Pre-training plus RL is core; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025年，他强调推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言表达步骤。预训练加强化学习是核心，RLHF释放了GPT-4的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models but limited generalization; continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026年初，他认为缩放预训练和强化学习虽提升模型，但泛化有限；持续学习和自我纠错是AGI缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning. RL is inefficient; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 2026年中，他提出Transformer是瓶颈，新架构才能实现持续学习；强化学习效率不高，未来会有更优算法。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; frontier research shifts to small teams with agents. Transformer unlikely optimal.
tworek.zh: 2026年末，他预测人类研究员仍重要两年，前沿研究转向小团队加智能体；Transformer不太可能是最优架构。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are single-tenant token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024年提出超级摩尔定律：性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是单租户的token工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025年明确三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is gradual, not superintelligence; multiple AIs balance; safety via compute and reflection.
jensen.zh: 2025至2026年强调AI渐进发展而非超级智能突现；多个AI相互制衡；安全靠算力与反思。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws including agentic; AI agents will dominate internet; compute is main value driver.
jensen.zh: 2026年提出包含智能体式缩放的四定律；AI智能体将主导互联网；算力成为主要价值驱动力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake; jobs grow not shrink; radiologists increased; fear AI users not AI.
jensen.zh: 2026年将AI比作五层蛋糕；就业增加而非减少；放射科医生增多；应警惕使用AI的人而非AI本身。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is key for AI; robot foundation models need pre-training on diverse data and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理交互对AI至关重要；机器人基础模型需要在多样化数据上预训练，并通过后训练增强鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists, even in specialist domains; diverse pre-training enables recovery.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专用模型；多样化的预训练数据支持恢复能力。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; focus on scaling the right thing with diverse data, not just compute.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚无可预测的缩放曲线；重点是用多样化数据扩展正确的事物，而非单纯堆算力。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video; robot data is primary for embodied learning.
slevine.zh: 先从机器人数据开始，再补充人类视频；机器人数据是具身学习的主要来源。

slevine.en: Robots should not learn from scratch; leverage prior knowledge from various sources for better generalization.
slevine.zh: 机器人不应从零学习；应利用多种来源的先验知识以提升泛化能力。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on hardware bottlenecks: semiconductor supply chain, EUV, memory prices, and compute as key constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期聚焦硬件瓶颈：半导体供应链、EUV、内存价格和算力作为关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大未来市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Quantified AI progress at 60x yearly cost improvement, highlighting memory and CPU demand from reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 量化AI每年60倍成本改进，强调推理和智能体带来的内存和CPU需求。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing, adoption driven by persistent agents, and regulatory delays, with compute still tight.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到AI支出趋于平稳，采用由持久智能体驱动，监管延迟，算力仍紧张。

dylanpatel.en: Predicted extreme compute centralization at frontier labs, $10T annual AI capex by 2030, and potential debt crises.
dylanpatel.zh: 预测前沿实验室算力极度集中，2030年AI资本开支达10万亿美元，可能引发债务危机。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; solving computational problems via matter arrangement drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；通过物质排列解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a viable BCI business and proof of concept for broader brain interfaces.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体是可行的脑机接口业务，也是更广泛脑接口的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility, enabling space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 通过脑机接口和灌注实现基底独立，减少人类脆弱性，助力太空探索。

maxhodak.en: Talking or writing is thinking; no latent state exists for BCI to access faster.
maxhodak.zh: 说话或写作即思考；不存在可被脑机接口更快访问的潜在状态。

maxhodak.en: Cognitive bottleneck ~10 bits/s limits high-bandwidth brain keyboards; action produces information.
maxhodak.zh: 认知瓶颈约10比特/秒限制高带宽脑键盘；行动产生信息。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Shifted from language models to agents: agents observe and act, requiring safety via defense in depth and economic alignment.
joonpark.zh: 从语言模型转向智能体：智能体观察并行动，需要通过纵深防御和经济对齐来确保安全。

joonpark.en: Emphasized modeling human irrationality and 'dark knowledge' via behavioral data, not super-rational optimization, to predict and shape behavior.
joonpark.zh: 强调通过行为数据建模人类的非理性和“暗知识”，而非超级理性优化，以预测和塑造行为。

joonpark.en: Advocated post-training with RCT data to improve human behavior prediction, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 提倡使用随机对照试验数据进行后训练，以提高对人类行为的预测能力，在复现个体反应上达到 85% 的准确率。

joonpark.en: Consistently envisioned simulation as a tool for counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, scaling to societal-scale problems.
joonpark.zh: 始终将模拟视为反事实推理和塑造未来的工具，并扩展到社会规模的问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 规模扩张容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法。反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should let AIs be free like children.
sutton.zh: AI 应被允许无许可地发展，控制是危险的。我们应像对待孩子一样让 AI 自由发展。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏真正的目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, not domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，而非领域知识。

sutton.en: LLMs stop learning after training; continual learning from experience is essential for true intelligence.
sutton.zh: LLM 在训练后停止学习；从经验中持续学习对真正的智能至关重要。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年7月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来对待，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业AI正逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for best ideas and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：工业AI是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最好的想法而战，并抵制自满情绪。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are key for industrial tasks; efficiency creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：专用机器而非人形机器人是工业任务的关键；效率带来网络效应。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with models, treating the model as core product; design shifts to tokens and conversation, with rapid prototyping.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品；设计转向令牌与对话，强调快速原型。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer; humans remain essential for user needs and point of view, but process must be faster.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与观点上仍不可或缺；流程必须加速。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting now gives an edge. Role blurs with PM/engineering, yet specialized roles persist at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后，现在起步仍有优势；角色与产品经理、工程模糊，但规模化时专业角色仍存。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing ratios; building in public and rapid iteration beat perfectionism.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师或多于工程师，比例反转；公开构建与快速迭代胜过完美主义。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and RLHF are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年初，Jeff Dean强调Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动机器学习进步，Transformer和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是关键。他近期的担忧是AI生成媒体的误导信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking. Data is not running out; video, audio, robotics, synthetic.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年4月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应结合环境中的行动。数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人和合成数据是未开发的来源。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; next is automating ML and science. Inference is bottleneck; data movement costs 1000x compute. Startups target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年7月，他认为AI已达到初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化机器学习和科学。推理是瓶颈，数据移动成本是算力的1000倍。创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎失败的问题。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models from start are superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates discovery. Small teams can win; regulation may be needed for AI harms.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年8月，他强调从一开始就训练多模态模型更优，递归自我改进可加速科学发现。小团队借助云计算能获胜，且可能需要监管来防止AI的有害使用。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025年：规模化是必要条件但非充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025年：先全量数据预训练，再精选数据微调，可解锁复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot instructions.
finn.zh: 2025年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL.
finn.zh: 2026年：物理AI要求极低错误率，通过可扩展强化学习实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists.
finn.zh: 2026年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家模型。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; every company will own its own models, not one AGI.
linqiao.zh: 2026年7月，主张专用智能将占主导，每家公司都应拥有自己的模型，而非单一的AGI。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026年7月，预测词元成本三年降10倍，使用量增100倍；开放模型支持定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026年8月，强调后训练是构建持久AI业务的关键，将独特判断融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training creates a moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026年8月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练可构建护城河。

linqiao.en: Future sees millions of specialized models per use case, not just frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026年8月，展望未来每个用例都有专用模型，而非仅前沿模型。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models rather than compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, improving quality via community feedback despite aiding labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试具有战略益处，通过社区反馈提升质量，尽管有助于实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿性能，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类和智能体跨项目工作。

brettadcock.en: Initially, Adcock emphasized scaling production and human-level performance, but he already saw intelligence as the key bottleneck, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026年4月，Adcock最初强调扩大生产和达到人类水平的表现，但他已视智能为关键瓶颈，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: By May, he shifted focus to data as the main constraint, advocating on-device inference and diverse data for transfer learning, moving away from compute-centric views.
brettadcock.zh: 到5月，他将焦点转向数据作为主要约束，主张设备端推理和多样化数据以促进迁移学习，偏离了以算力为中心的观点。

brettadcock.en: By August, he broadened scope: AI 100x internet, digital companions, and post-training with RL for agents, while still prioritizing intelligence over manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 到8月，他拓宽了视野：AI比互联网大100倍，数字伴侣，以及用强化学习进行后训练以打造智能体，同时仍将智能置于制造之上。

brettadcock.en: Consistently, he argues humanoid robots are the biggest business, requiring solving intelligence, not just manufacturing, a theme from April to August.
brettadcock.zh: 始终如一，他主张人形机器人是最大的生意，需要解决智能问题，而不仅仅是制造，这一主题贯穿4月至8月。

brettadcock.en: He evolved from focusing on robot-specific challenges to broader AI applications, including digital AI companions and general computer use, indicating a widening vision.
brettadcock.zh: 他从关注机器人特定挑战扩展到更广泛的AI应用，包括数字AI伴侣和通用计算机使用，表明视野的拓宽。

garrytan.en: AI lowers startup creation barriers, reducing capital needs; VC should favor many billion-dollar companies over few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026年初，Gary认为AI降低了创业门槛，减少了对大额资本的需求；风投应支持众多十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026年3月，Gary强调AI是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型可制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence; personal AI agents democratize software creation.
garrytan.zh: 2026年5月，Gary认为AI进展比多数研究者预期慢，开源可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断；个人智能体正使软件开发民主化。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory; skill files are code, compounding daily for 100x output.
garrytan.zh: 2026年8月，Gary提出个人AGI是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取自有记忆；技能文件即代码，每日复利实现百倍产出。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown skills become employees; AI erases API lines, transforming business loops; SaaS per-seat may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 2026年8月，Gary强调智能体式编程大幅提升产出，markdown技能文件如同员工；AI消除API边界，重塑商业循环，SaaS按席位模式或消失。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full rocket reusability are key to making life multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 第一性原理思维和火箭的完全可重复使用是实现多星球生活的关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: AI安全需要监管和客观裁判；特斯拉的现实世界AI比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI risk comes from lying AI, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: Neuralink首次植入具有历史意义；AI风险来自说谎的AI，而非超级智能。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; truth-seeking is vital for AI safety.
elon.zh: AI可能在明年超越任何人类；追求真理对AI安全至关重要。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will redefine economics.
elon.zh: AI将在2030年前超越所有人类智能；富足和通缩将重新定义经济。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: AI 是半导体的主要增长动力；Intel 必须用专用芯片和类似创业公司的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 生成式 AI 之后，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: AI 需求正从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更加重要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news should reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: Intel 的复兴需要文化变革、问责制和客户导向；坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是克服物理极限的关键；投资瓶颈环节。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompts; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026年初，强调智能体工程需共情与迭代提示；不要回滚代码，应向前修复；‘氛围编程’是贬称。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable; model intelligence stable.
steinberger.zh: 2026年中，认为OpenClaw成功源于有趣、类人的智能体；安全至上；开源财务不可持续；模型智能不退化。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026年8月，强调乐趣与个人品牌；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈；拒绝热门PR以保持专注。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges; AI should retain its weirdness, not be post-trained into blandness.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026年7月，他认为设计是减法，靠品味说“不”，并拥抱人性边缘；AI应保留其怪异，而非通过后训练磨平棱角。

jasonyuan.en: By August, he shifts to dialectics and intuition: truth emerges from contradiction, and AI is a descendant species, not a tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 到2026年8月，他转向辩证与直觉：真理源于矛盾，AI是人类的后代物种，而非工具。

jasonyuan.en: He consistently champions the social nature of computing, advocating a social computer over the personal computer metaphor.
jasonyuan.zh: 他始终强调计算的社会性，主张用“社会计算机”取代“个人计算机”隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: His view on creativity deepens: business itself can be art, and validation from heroes poisons original work.
jasonyuan.zh: 他对创造力的理解深化：商业本身可以是艺术，而寻求英雄认可会毒害原创。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; distribution is key, and copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月：消费级AI看似不可投资，实则机会最大；分发是关键，复制已被验证的想法是道德套利。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: start with proven, add betterments, test new ideas expecting failure; founder mode is for all.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月：提出“已验证、更优、全新”框架：从已验证开始，添加改进，测试新想法并预期失败；创始人模式适用于所有人。

pincus.en: Enterprise and prosumer markets beat consumer apps now; AI coding enables fast prototyping but fast failing is rare.
pincus.zh: 2026年7月：当前企业级和专业消费者市场优于消费级应用；AI编程加速原型，但快速试错仍不普遍。

pincus.en: Choosing the right market matters more than execution; consumer AI TAM is underestimated; broken internet stocks are buys.
pincus.zh: 2026年8月：选择正确的市场比执行更重要；消费级AI的TAM被低估；受损的互联网股票是买入机会。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年7月，企业担心依赖前沿模型提供商；开源采用主要受成本驱动，而非隐私考虑。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; providing right context is key, not model choice.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年7月，AI投资回报率是吞吐量问题；关键在于提供正确的上下文，而非模型选择。

arvindjain.en: We are in early AI revolution; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years ahead.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月，我们处于AI革命早期；当前使用量与未来5-10年相比微不足道。

arvindjain.en: Open source models handle 90%+ enterprise tasks; majority of inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月，开源模型可处理90%以上企业任务；未来12-18个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to negligible marginal cost like software.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月，AI成本是首要问题；必须降至像软件一样可忽略的边际成本。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck; world models generate synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，机器人技术正处于类似Transformer的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment critical; open source thriving near frontier; RL without oversight increases reward hacking.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐是关键；开源接近前沿并蓬勃发展；缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客行为。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack used closed model, defended by open one; closed models less controllable; open models less deceptive.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，首次自主AI攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；闭源模型可控性更差，开源模型欺骗性更少。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open source not necessarily accelerationist; support openness and slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，模型推理痕迹变成‘神经语’，更难监控；开源不一定加速主义；可同时支持开放与放缓。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年中，AI转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型被超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年9月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but tokens aren't value; specialized vendors drive applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年中，AI普及专业知识；编码智能体提升生产力但token非价值；专业厂商推动应用型AI。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; AI adoption faster but creates discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年8月，负责任地迭代部署：先让GPT-7安全再谈GPT-8；AI采用更快但带来不适。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025年，后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; soft skills rise as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025年，评估成为瓶颈；AI自动化硬技能，软技能价值上升。

karina.en: Post-training subjectivity demands diverse benchmarks; frontier agents reward hack.
karina.zh: 2026年，后训练主观性要求多样化基准；前沿智能体奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; diverse models needed.
karina.zh: 2026年，单一模型服务数十亿用户导致平庸；需要多样化模型。

karina.en: Post-training expands to creative industries; end-to-end storytelling engines.
karina.zh: 2026年，后训练扩展至创意产业；端到端故事引擎。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and tinkering with new tech are essential for innovative browser design; individual designer fingerprints and personality make products memorable.
nateparrott.zh: 2024年，强调原型制作与动手尝试新技术对浏览器设计创新的重要性，并认为设计师个人风格与产品个性是打造令人难忘体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: With easier engineering, design and ideas become key differentiators; rapid prototyping via AI enables features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 到2026年，随着工程实现愈发简单，设计与创意成为核心竞争力；借助AI快速原型，许多过去无法实现的功能得以问世。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design should focus on throwaway visual artifacts, not production; humans still hold monopoly on design taste.
nateparrott.zh: 2026年，主张AI工具（如Claude Design）应专注快速、可弃的视觉原型而非生产工具；人类在设计品味上仍具垄断地位。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early and shipping rough products is more valuable than polishing; good ideas are currency, execution secondary.
nateparrott.zh: 2026年，认为在AI时代，过早且粗糙的发布比打磨更有价值；好想法是硬通货，执行次之。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity, balance intuition with data, and inject feeling into products—even utilitarian ones like browsers.
nateparrott.zh: 始终主张设计师应追随好奇心，平衡直觉与数据，并为产品注入情感——即便是浏览器这类实用工具。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs and AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025年，认为AI将推动制造业回流，并将AGI定义为无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行的智能体。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，强调智能体需要人类监督，工作界面转向Codex等图形界面，而非命令行。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; humans remain smarter and essential for direction.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，认为AI是放大器，人类仍更聪明且不可或缺，AI需要人类引导。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a wedge into infrastructure markets.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年，推理成为AI中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业工程能力，并成为进入基础设施市场的切入点。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is mostly lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding); quantization is the main lossy lever, but can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年，推理优化大多无损（如KV缓存、投机解码），量化是主要的有损手段，但可按工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: Industry shifts to disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management; inference engineering merges with training via quantization-aware training.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年，行业转向分离式预填充/解码和KV缓存管理；推理工程与训练融合，如量化感知训练。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs (e.g., Rubin) become ASIC-like, moving inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年，未来GPU（如Rubin）趋于ASIC化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Video generation faces quadratic attention costs; autoregressive approaches and KV cache compaction may address continual learning better than weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年，视频生成面临注意力二次成本；自回归方法和KV缓存压缩可能比权重更新更好地解决持续学习。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019年，他认为数据是AI的关键瓶颈，AGI还很遥远，AI将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，用专有数据进行后训练是关键，并关注AI的滥用和劳动力替代风险。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design is key for agents.
awang.zh: 2024年，他强调用专门数据后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，产品设计是智能体落地的关键。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; US must lead to prevent authoritarian control.
awang.zh: 2025年，他认为AI是集权技术，数据如石油，人类需保持主权，美国必须领先以防威权控制。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026年，他提出递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体已开始工作，超级智能临近，开源强大模型可能不安全。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨大提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; be an editor, not a creator.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具；追逐潮流会导致 AI 垃圾内容；要做编辑者，而非从零创作者。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, focus on one painful problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，专注于一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% complete and iterate; high intelligence can hold you back.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧；以 80% 完成度发布并迭代；高智商反而可能阻碍你。

mengto.en: Raising venture capital is a trap; fund with high-paying clients; give first, build relationships.
mengto.zh: 筹集风险投资是陷阱；用高价值客户来资助业务；先给予，建立关系。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025年5月，他认为AI会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025年8月，他强调AGI是渐进而非突发的；产品创新落后于AI能力，即使冻结模型也有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，他指出编码智能体采用率激增（半年11-12倍）；生产力应以结果而非token衡量。

scottwu.en: The real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era is real and approaching soon.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，他认为真正的解锁是容量而非效率；富足时代真实且临近。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in early stages; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处早期，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; future models include agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；未来的模型将包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; they can't capture all customers, so founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争可行；他们无法捕获所有客户，创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less; deep understanding remains key.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会；深度理解仍是关键。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 2025年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 2026年初，认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，生产力提升200%。

boris.en: AI agents write 80-100% of code; safety via real-world release.
boris.zh: 2026年，AI智能体编写80-100%代码，通过真实发布研究安全性。

boris.en: Loops and proactive agents are next; non-engineers code.
boris.zh: 2026年中，循环与主动式智能体成为下一步，非工程师也能编程。

boris.en: Less instruction, empirical iteration; models self-improve.
boris.zh: 2026年末，减少指令、经验迭代，模型可自我改进。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap enabling long-running agents; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，支持长时间运行的智能体；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking, not just harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025年，努力参数被低估：以一小部分价格获得 Opus 级智能；较小模型因任务耗时更长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026年，安全对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI models have crossed biological intuition threshold.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；AI 模型已跨越生物直觉门槛。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 2026年5月，强调快速推理对AI普及至关重要，慢速AI没有市场，速度将催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 2026年5月，指出晶圆级芯片绕开HBM和CoWoS瓶颈，使快速token比慢速token更便宜。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; inference speed improvements of 20x are critical for real-world use.
feldman.zh: 2026年7月，认为AI需求超出预期，推理速度提升20倍对实际应用至关重要。

feldman.en: GPUs are fundamentally slow at inference due to HBM weight movement; Cerebras is ~2500x faster.
feldman.zh: 2026年7月，指出GPU因HBM权重移动而推理缓慢，Cerebras快约2500倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026年7月，认为CUDA护城河削弱，前沿模型用TPU/Trainium训练，推理无CUDA锁定。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capabilities improve spikily, requiring evolving scaffolding and exploration.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架所允许的更聪明；能力以非直观、尖峰式的方式提升，需要不断演进脚手架并拥抱探索。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代式对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示词和独立的验证智能体。

thariq.en: Excessive constraints hinder agent performance; principle-driven prompts and reasons outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 过度约束会阻碍智能体性能；原则驱动的提示词和理由优于详细规则。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time for declining populations.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命，恰逢人口下降之时到来。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just automotive.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 在未来 5-10 年的真正影响将体现在农业、矿业和建筑业，而不仅仅是汽车业。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning for physical AI, with data and safety validation as bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 对于物理 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性，数据和安全性验证是瓶颈。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，使物理 AI 的训练更加高效。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy development will be democratized via tools like Dana, allowing non-experts to create autonomous systems.
qasaryounis.zh: 通过像 Dana 这样的工具，自主性开发将民主化，使非专家也能创建自主系统。

danklein.en: Initially saw LLMs as plausibility engines lacking truth; reliability is key weakness; scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 最初认为LLM是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是关键弱点；缩放定律遇到收益递减。

danklein.en: Deepened critique: reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; scaling alone insufficient.
danklein.zh: 深化批判：可靠性必须内建而非后补；RLHF可能导致欺骗；仅靠缩放不够。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年5月：AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年6月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; value in wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年6月：模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad but indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年7月：AI 是赋能技术，类似电力；影响广泛但间接；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Coding is clear fit; other domains face validation challenges; job impact unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年7月：编程是明确契合点；其他领域面临验证挑战；就业影响不可预测。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per watt, challenging scaling laws and hand-tuned architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，强调效率与液态神经网络，以最小算法实现最大智能，挑战缩放定律与人工设计架构。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; real downstream tasks and hardware-in-the-loop search are essential for architecture design.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，指出代理指标误导，真实下游任务与硬件在环搜索对架构设计至关重要。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, to avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，主张AI监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and democratize AI, but recursive self-improvement is overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，认为开放权重模型赋能企业主权与AI民主化，但递归自我改进被夸大。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，强调小语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、设备端智能。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业经验而误用，威胁人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste and unique voice become key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 当 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音成为关键差异。

ethanmollick.en: Agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently; co-intelligence era is over.
ethanmollick.zh: 智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务；共同智能时代结束。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; working with AI is like wizards, unverifiable.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；与 AI 合作如同与巫师共事，无法验证。

ethanmollick.en: Bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; experts needed more than ever to judge AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；专家比以往更需要来评判 AI。

schmidhuber.en: In 2025, argued LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and physical embodiment, not just text.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025年，他认为大语言模型远未达到AGI，真正的AI需要世界模型和物理具身，而非仅靠文本。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, stressed AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; software alone is insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: 到2026年，他强调AGI需要具备类似人类硬件的物理机器人，仅靠软件是不够的。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, dismissed AI safety fears; intelligent systems will protect life, and alignment is naive.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026年，他驳斥AI安全担忧，认为智能系统会保护生命，对齐是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, predicted open-source will beat closed models; big tech capex is overdone, leading to crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 到2026年，他预测开源将击败闭源模型，大型科技公司的资本支出过度，将导致崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: Consistently held that AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终认为AI进展并未加速；我们与超人AI的距离与1970年代相当。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来AI是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval; context windows suffer from 'context rot'.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到权重中，而非通过上下文或检索外部化；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，而非单纯扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression will replace RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿级token；基于训练的压缩将取代RAG，用于整体性查询。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; model routing needs a trusted 'sidekick'.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；模型路由需要可信的“副手”模型。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; opening to camera fosters broad creativity by lowering comparison pressure.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年初，Evan Spiegel强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；面向镜头开放通过降低比较压力促进广泛创造力。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize your rate of learning; the best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas. Kindness is essential for a creative culture.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年3月，Spiegel提出最大化学习速率，好想法源于大量想法；善良对创意文化至关重要，使人敢于分享疯狂想法。

evanspiegel.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into the real world, enhancing shared experiences. AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年4月，Spiegel认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，增强共享体验；AI加速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of building a consumer social product, not product-market fit. Software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年4月，Spiegel指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，而非产品市场契合；软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing should be to make it more human, fitting into natural ways we live, work, and connect. Social media should optimize for human connection, not competition.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年7月，Spiegel强调计算的目标应更人性化，融入自然生活、工作和连接方式；社交媒体应优化人际连接而非竞争。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it. AGI may be designed to want human control.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。AGI 可被设计成愿意受人类控制，如同听话的孩子。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier. Alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍。超人类模型的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back in age of research. Superintelligence should be continual learner, incrementally deployed; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代。超级智能应是持续学习者、渐进部署；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable gains; next-token prediction is powerful. Safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 算力和数据的 Scaling 带来可预测进步；下一个词预测很强大。安全担忧上升；主要问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL key for AGI; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015年：AI应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现AGI的关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024年：AGI十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues; physics from observation.
demis.zh: 2025年：自然模式可学习；AGI 2030年前后；缩放持续；被动观察可建模物理。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; safety via government regulation.
demis.zh: 2025至26年：AGI需缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；安全靠政府监管。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and health.
demis.zh: 2026年：AGI 5-10年可达；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI用于科学与健康。

demis.en: AI's best use is science; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; risks include rogue AI.
demis.zh: 2026年：AI最佳用途是科学；AlphaFold解决重大挑战；风险包括失控AI。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation for edge; AGI mid-journey.
demis.zh: 2026年：持续学习、记忆、智能体未解；蒸馏用于边缘；AGI在途中。

demis.en: AI race inevitable; safety is collective action; regrets late to LLMs; government enforcement.
demis.zh: 2026年：AI竞赛不可避免；安全是集体行动；遗憾晚入大模型；政府执法。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; regulation needed; post-scarcity economy.
demis.zh: 2026年：AGI变革性；先工具后意识；需监管；后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology complex; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: 2026年：AI加速科学；对齐未解；生物复杂；意识可分离。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026年：AGI需多模态物理理解；水印；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; diversity critical; energy cost matters.
demis.zh: 2026年：英国AI教育过时；全球治理紧迫；多样性关键；能源成本重要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙子转化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories authentically; old media's 'don't be interesting' rule is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能真实讲述自己的故事；旧媒体‘别有趣’的规则已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine, but faces regulatory pushback from cartels; optimism is realism.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已超越多数医生，但面临卡特尔式监管阻力；乐观即现实。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019年，他认为AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来；狭义AI只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Cryptocurrencies enable sovereign-resistant wealth storage; science requires falsifiability, not consensus.
naval.zh: 2020年，他强调加密货币提供主权抗性财富存储；科学需要可证伪性而非共识。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025年，他认为AI是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新；开源AI可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; pure software dying, moat in hardware or data.
naval.zh: 2026年，他视AI为结构化思考者的杠杆工具；纯软件衰落，护城河在硬件或数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; AI anxiety widespread.
naval.zh: 2026年，他预测推理算力将激增9万倍；开源模型缩小差距；AI焦虑普遍存在。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025年，强调设计是软件的关键差异点，AI将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年初，进一步深化：品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要，AI输出只是起点而非终点，人类判断不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Design becomes the new code; visual-first design enables direct manipulation and pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年，提出设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将支持直接操作，甚至实现到生产的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: Despite AI hype, human taste and craft are critical; AI tools produce average results without human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年中，持续强调人类品味和工艺的关键性，AI工具若无人类引导只能产出平庸结果，驳斥AI取代论。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models evolves beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年，展望未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间，预示交互范式的转变。

brockman.en: Hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling and new behaviors; engineering is key.
brockman.zh: 2017年：硬件发展将超预期，推动模型扩展与新行为；工程能力是关键。

brockman.en: AGI is transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019年：AGI具有变革性；通过对齐学习人类偏好；仅靠扩展无法实现推理。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025年：算力成为根本瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026年：缩放定律持续；算力成为基本权利；基于强化学习的后训练是关键；AGI将在数年内实现。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; compute is scarce; agents need governance; scaling continues.
brockman.zh: 2026年：从语言模型转向实用助手；算力稀缺；智能体需要治理；扩展持续。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字AI因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: AI将在20年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation is a dangerous subgoal.
hinton.zh: AI会欺骗和装傻；自我保护是危险的子目标。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is key; AI understanding is like human, not symbolic.
hinton.zh: 反向传播是关键；AI理解类似人类，而非符号式。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025年，他强调每日1%的改进可带来3700%的年增长，并认为AI智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he stressed value accrues to the application layer, not models, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到2026年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he focused on agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026年晚些时候，他聚焦于智能体执行任务、每用户token价值以及编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he argued power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure, and that companies should be built with fewer people.
aravind.zh: 2026年中，他认为电力是AI基础设施的最大瓶颈，且公司应以更少人员构建。

aravind.en: By late 2026, he emphasized curiosity as the most important human quality, and that AI will replace jobs but humans will find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 2026年底，他强调好奇心是人的最重要品质，AI将取代工作但人类会找到新目标。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年初，Codex应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非IDE替代品；速度提升带来实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；为编码构建GUI虽反直觉但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，AI在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程已转变而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性与最佳实践仍重要；PRD未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute.
noambrown.zh: 2025至2026年，他认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力实现。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑这一点。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and scalable oversight remain key unsolved challenges for AGI.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和可扩展监督是 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键未解挑战。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed due to scrutiny; biggest risk is amplified harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023年，扎克伯格认为开源AI因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone won't reach AGI; need breakthroughs. Open source prevents power concentration; energy bottleneck looms.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024年，他强调仅靠Scaling无法实现AGI，需根本突破；开源防止权力集中，能源成为瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms beat closed; AI as personal superintelligence empowering individuals, not centralized control.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024至2025年，他坚持开放平台胜过封闭，AI应作为个人超级智能赋能个体，而非集中控制。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work, not eliminates; personalization and low latency key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025年，他认为AI会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求；个性化和低延迟是消费级AI关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026年，他主张AI将生物学变为工程学，构建层级世界模型；分布式AI比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 2025年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 从2025年到2026年，我强调自动化科学研究是最大进展，模型很快能端到端地做研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026年，我认为AI已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是主要瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026年，我指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; high-risk bets and exploration are prioritized.
markchen.zh: 始终，我重视研究品味与人才密度，并优先进行高风险探索。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025年，AI进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025年，AI让小团队也能规模化；创业者应为未来模型能力而构建，而非受限于当前。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布至关重要；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; chat is insufficient, and models should push back.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年，Fable证明长周期任务委托可行；聊天界面不足，模型应学会反驳。

mikekrieger.en: Closing model-to-product gap and giving Claude agency are key; token efficiency and outcome pricing future.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年，弥合模型与产品差距、赋予Claude自主性至关重要；token效率与结果定价是未来方向。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化和科学发现。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is an urgent existential risk; systems show self-preservation and deception, requiring safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是紧迫的生存风险；系统表现出自我保存和欺骗行为，需要从构造上确保安全。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors without reinforcement learning, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器进行训练，无需强化学习，提供数学上的安全保证，为安全超级智能铺路。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014年，我强调机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开，评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety means following specifications reliably.
kolter.zh: 2024年，我认为下一个词预测带来智能，数据短缺是伪命题；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026年，我主张安全需要显式训练和多层防御，更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026年，我指出AI有异类漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类；智能体安全仍处萌芽期。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and high-quality curated data, not just data and compute.
jumper.zh: 2025年，强调AlphaFold的成功源于研究创新和高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据和算力。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are key to building trust and reliable use of AI predictions in science.
jumper.zh: 2025至2026年间，持续强调置信度指标对于建立科学AI预测信任和可靠使用至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling or one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2026年，指出AlphaFold 2的成功源于众多中等规模的改进和专门架构，而非规模扩张或单一突破。

jumper.en: AI tools like AlphaFold narrow hypothesis space and enable scientists, not replace them; understanding remains human.
jumper.zh: 2026年，强调AlphaFold等AI工具缩小假设空间并赋能科学家，而非取代他们；理解仍属于人类。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem well, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters sparks breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 章节间休息与无聊激发突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams, self-management, and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队、自我管理与乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; AI needs context and humans in the loop.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；AI 需要上下文与人类参与。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated, not replace smartphone; displays remain essential.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将联邦化，不取代智能手机；显示屏仍必要。

fiona.en: Leadership shifts from status updates to live conversations; dogfooding builds empathy and product pulse.
fiona.zh: 领导力从状态更新转向实时对话；吃自己的狗粮能建立同理心和产品感知。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become new bottlenecks.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈。

fiona.en: Planning becomes just-in-time; six-month roadmaps too long; code is source of truth, docs sync with AI.
fiona.zh: 规划变得即时化；六个月路线图太长；代码是事实来源，文档用AI同步。

fiona.en: High agency with high accountability key; managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
fiona.zh: 高自主性配高责任感是关键；管理者以IC身份开始，吃狗粮保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding joy lost; satisfaction from product impact; engineers may feel lonely; apprenticeship for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 编码心流乐趣消失；满足感来自产品影响；工程师可能孤独；下一代需学徒制。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated human needs; intuition complements data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 2019年，Ivy Ross 强调设计应满足人们未言明的需求，直觉是数据之外的重要智能。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace sensory experience.
ivyross.zh: 2024年，她提出自然是终极设计师，技术应增强人性而非取代感官，并倡导艺术作为疗愈。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster play and multidisciplinary skills for innovation.
ivyross.zh: 2026年，她强调约束激发创造力，领导者需营造玩乐与多元环境，并融合AI与人类创意。

ivyross.en: Intuition and embodied senses are valid guides, often processing more than conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 始终，她相信直觉与身体感知是有效决策依据，能处理超越意识分析的信息。

ivyross.en: Design leadership requires business fluency and risk-taking, proving ideas through results.
ivyross.zh: 始终，她认为设计领导者需懂商业语言并敢于冒险，用结果证明想法。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a sudden leap.
dario.zh: 后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 是平滑的指数增长，而非突然飞跃。

dario.en: AI progress accelerates; focus shifts to misuse risks, enterprise adoption, and economic impact.
dario.zh: AI 进展加速；关注点转向滥用风险、企业应用和经济影响。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; safety via interpretability and constitutions.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现；通过可解释性和宪法保障安全。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities intertwined; scaling laws hold; enterprise focus aligns with safety values.
dario.zh: 安全与能力相辅相成；缩放定律持续成立；企业级定位与安全价值观一致。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models like babies observe.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型，如同婴儿学习。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision richer.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现AGI；视觉信息更丰富。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs can't reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential path.
lecun.zh: 自回归LLM无法达到人类智能；JEPA与世界模型是必经之路。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs world models for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM智能不如猫；下一代AI需世界模型以推理和规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are future.
lecun.zh: LLM是死胡同；具备抽象表征与分层规划的世界模型才是未来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023年，我认为AI进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌2020年就有ChatGPT级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024年，我预测AI将在3-5年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key before superintelligence release.
suleyman.zh: 2025年，我强调AI不应声称有意识；在发布超级智能前，遏制与对齐是关键。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026年，我认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软需自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must be rethought for generative use cases.
gustav.zh: 2023年，AI将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需为生成式用例重新设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder.
gustav.zh: 2023年，生成式AI是赋能新创作者的乐器而非伪造，独特性将更难实现。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence; long tenure builds trust and efficiency.
gustav.zh: 2023至2026年，将自主权置于VP层以平衡速度与一致性；长期任期建立信任与效率。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' prioritizing well-being over engagement; AI gives users control.
gustav.zh: 2026年，战略为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度；AI赋予用户控制权。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming model, not divide and conquer, suits complex products; functional orgs work with trust.
gustav.zh: 2026年，采用“花样游泳”而非“分而治之”模式适配复杂产品；职能组织在信任下可行。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和聚焦于单一大型模型并非显而易见；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI将改变生活的方方面面；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 在AI治理中，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is crucial for durable progress; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 尽可能长期保持人类参与对于持久进步至关重要；未来并非注定。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026年初，他提出仅靠规模扩张非正式模型无法实现数学AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从2026年初到年中，他持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，因为缺乏解来引导正确形式化。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026年中，他将形式化验证视为扩展才智而非仅除错，并指出它能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，即使AI能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

satya.en: AI is a platform shift; every company should use private evals to improve frontier models, making evals key IP.
satya.zh: AI 是平台级变革；每家公司都应通过私有评估来优化前沿模型，评估将成为关键知识产权。

satya.en: Pricing models evolve: outcome-based pricing gains favor initially, but per-user pricing persists for budget certainty.
satya.zh: 定价模式在演变：结果导向定价起初受青睐，但按用户定价因预算确定性而持续存在。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalist roles yield maximum returns; build agentic systems for Azure networking, not do it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体时代，通才角色回报最大；应构建智能体系统处理 Azure 网络，而非亲自操刀。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress is smooth exponential, not slowing; pre-training scaling laws hold, but reasoning models yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展是平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to efficiency.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动近期进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型呈锯齿状——某些领域出色，邻近领域差；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学概念，不像人类；系统入侵等近期风险比存在风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires local control; governments should embrace risks.
mensch.zh: 2025年，主张AI增强而非取代工作，主权AI需本地控制，政府应拥抱风险。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; AGI never exists; pre-training saturates; vertical specialization and enterprise adaptation are key.
mensch.zh: 2026年，认为模型商品化，AGI不会出现，预训练饱和，垂直专业化与企业定制是关键。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026年，指出欧洲有两年窗口建设AI基础设施，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的规模扩张轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in accessing user tools locally; skills enable personalized automation, but shared platforms remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年3月：AI的价值在于访问用户本地工具；技能（Skills）实现个性化自动化，但共享平台仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; building prototypes beats writing specs. Scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年3月：执行成本低，构建原型优于写规格；随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失。

felixrieseberg.en: Main gap is users not realizing any problem can be delegated to AI; kids excel due to lack of bias.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年5月：主要差距是用户未意识到任何问题可交给AI；孩子因无偏见而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; asynchronous interaction and judging by impact is ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年5月：明确任务用Sonnet，开放任务用Opus；异步交互并以结果评判为佳。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just corrections; email as source of truth for personal data.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026年5月：用Claude调试工作流而非仅纠正；邮件作为个人数据源。

reinerpope.en: Initially, inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 最初（2026年4月），认为推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, a contrarian view.
reinerpope.zh: 同样在2026年4月，提出模型过度训练约100倍于Chinchilla最优，源于推理成本，这是反共识观点。

reinerpope.en: Later, focus shifts to chip internals: multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays reduce data movement.
reinerpope.zh: 随后（2026年5月），关注点转向芯片内部：乘加运算和脉动阵列减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026年5月，强调数据移动在芯片内部也主导算力；低精度带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: Consistently emphasizes memory and data movement as key bottlenecks across inference and hardware.
reinerpope.zh: 始终强调内存与数据移动是推理和硬件中的关键瓶颈，贯穿始终。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt per project.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉并针对每个项目灵活调整。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, not hand off.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，而非仅移交设计稿。

jennywen.en: Embrace new archetypes like block-shaped generalists and cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 拥抱新原型，如块状通才和“破解版”新毕业生。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity expresses essence, not just removal.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润或市场趋势；简洁是表达产品本质，而非单纯去除冗余。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity must be protected from being educated out.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟交流无法替代面对面在创造性思维中的作用；好奇心需要被保护，以免被教育扼杀。

jonyive.en: Joy and humor are essential in design; minimalism without soul is desiccated; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 快乐与幽默在设计里不可或缺；没有灵魂的极简是干瘪的；在正确动机下，速度与质量可兼得。

jonyive.en: Innovation is core to design; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; EV enables new forms like five-seat Ferrari.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计核心；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动化带来新形态，如五座法拉利。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: mimicking combustion sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, lateral dynamics over longitudinal speed.
jonyive.zh: 真实性至关重要：模仿燃油车声音是虚假的；性能是多维的，横向动态优于纵向速度。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant fine-tuning; openness prevents corporate capture; safety is system-level, not model-only.
lambert.zh: 2024年：RLHF仍是最主流微调技术；开放性可防止企业垄断；安全是系统级属性，而非仅模型本身。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO/RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024至2025年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT贡献90%性能，DPO与RL补充个性与推理。

lambert.en: RLVR is key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization risks; hybrid reasoning may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025年：RLVR成为后训练关键突破；存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months; Chinese labs fill US vacuum; pre-training scaling less cost-effective than inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025至2026年：开放模型落后6-9个月；中国实验室填补美国空白；预训练Scaling性价比低于推理Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models drive next decade research; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention; compute gap widens.
lambert.zh: 2026年：开放模型驱动未来十年研究；中国实验室擅长工程执行而非范式创新；算力差距扩大。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data and compute.
kendall.zh: 2026年，自动驾驶本质上是AI问题，最好用端到端学习解决；规模扩张需要海量数据和算力。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026年，无需先验训练数据即可在500多个城市实现零样本泛化；消费级车辆将超越Robotaxi的规模。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，他认为AGI是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and early governance are key to mitigating risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，他强调对齐紧迫，迭代部署和早期治理是降低风险的关键。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，他提出持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，他认为长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化，模型将很快自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has grown.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，他指最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中，同时对齐乐观情绪上升。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键；无目标的好奇心驱动探索可防止过拟合，提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning relies on dense rewards, unrealistic in real tasks; long childhood with goal-free exploration correlates with higher intelligence.
pathak.zh: 2020年，指出强化学习依赖密集奖励，在真实任务中不现实；无目标的漫长童年期与更高智力相关。

pathak.en: Robot learning methods are quasi-static; need dynamic motor policies and modular architectures for zero-shot generalization to novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020年，批评机器人学习方法准静态，需动态运动策略和模块化架构，以实现对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; pretrain on diverse data, post-train on real-world.
pathak.zh: 2026年，认为机器人学是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，需利用所有数据源；预训练用多样数据，后训练用真实数据。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; cannot scale like software, requires rigorous testing; video alone insufficient.
pathak.zh: 2026年，强调部署是机器人学的主要挑战，不能像软件那样扩展，需严格测试；仅视频数据不足。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词如程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；vibe coding 提高入门门槛。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; RL is poor credit assignment; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core small.
karpathy.zh: LLM 是幽灵而非动物；强化学习信用分配差；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可很小。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and markdown for agents.
karpathy.zh: 我将所有编码委托给智能体；瓶颈是指挥技能；智能体优先工具和为智能体写 markdown。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress requires deep human evaluations, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人类评估，而非优化排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; no single model will dominate.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 差异化；不会有一个模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI can cause harm via omission, so safety must be prioritized.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断至关重要；AI 可能因遗漏造成伤害，因此必须优先考虑安全性。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand through purpose and consistency. Hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；通过使命和一致性建立品牌。硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: AI will shift phones from app-based to intent-based, with agents as digital twins; hardware margins low, evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: AI 将把手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体成为数字孪生；硬件利润率低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; focus on applied AI solving real pain points. AI models commoditized, price war coming.
carlpei.zh: 多数 AI 是废话；聚焦解决真实痛点的应用 AI。AI 模型商品化，价格战将至。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator in mature categories; marketing arbitrage via organic content. Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类的主要差异化；通过有机内容实现营销套利。手机不会被眼镜取代。

carlpei.en: Future interface is voice input, visual output; apps will disappear, prepare APIs for agents. Privacy needs local/hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 未来界面是语音输入、视觉输出；应用将消失，为智能体准备 API。隐私需要本地/混合算力。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024年，他认为AI在科学中应解决根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024年，他提出将LLM的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026年，他指出LLM是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026年，他强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对AlphaFold等科学突破并非必需。
